#include "ara/per/shared_handle.h"

Handle to a file storage or key-value storage. This is returned by the functions OpenFile
Storage() and OpenKeyValueStorage() and can be passed between threads as needed. It
provides the abstraction that is necessary to allow thread-safe implementation of OpenFile
Storage() and OpenKeyValueStorage().
